findings.claim: Acceptance criteria are not mapped to their case ids.
Auto tree for the ask() conversion comes from the hook input cwd / CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (GUARD_BASE pattern), never from CWD (the -C target).

findings.closure: Closure: the -C allow requires the -C toplevel to equal the hook input cwd's toplevel (BASE_DIR) only, and the second-worktree case sets a record in that worktree on another branch.
